# Vendored dependency

`nlohmann/json.hpp` is the unmodified single header from JSON for Modern C++ **v3.12.0**, under the included MIT license.

- Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.12.0
- Header: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp
- License: `nlohmann/LICENSE.MIT`

The header is checked in so a C++ build does not fetch packages from the network. It is used for structured configuration loading and the additive analytics telemetry object.
